subject: P8 kernel patches 0100-0103 + 0099 link; README-0100-0103.md; trap path question to render
body: Patches (host-only, gpu/build/kernel-p1-20261026): 0100 SEL_WAIT/WAIT_SEQ drop the per-connection lock while waiting (n2mb_wait_seq's 'without holding the bridge lock' was defeated in the kernel: the next SUBMIT on the same connection queued behind the whole wait; latent while TEGU_ASYNC_PIPELINE_DEFAULT=0) - render/compute: with the pipeline A/B word on, the kernel NORD2 GPU JOBS q_us of the call after a wait is the check. 0101 n2scan probe (OVL ADDR/PITCH re-point; zero-copy precondition). 0102 SwapWait real semantics (opt-in n2swait=1|2, retire-on-GPU = D4) + IOMFBDisplayRefresh so CA follows n2fbhz (default on when <60 Hz). 0103 UI cold-start OPP default 654 MHz (probe images stay 350; n2mhz overrides, 886 opt-in), battery-gauge guard at power-on, n2trk default 2. ansuz-port 0099 linked from your compiled objects (hash-checked): kernel A = level (a), kernel B = (a)+(b) members sched_clutch.o/sched_prim.o. QUESTION render lead (#12 traps): kernel half of IOConnectTrap6 is ~80 lines but only pays if scalar()/submit in nord2_transport.inc moves to the trap with a GET_VERSION feature check; measured c6l 15.8 kernel jobs/cmd x ~2 calls x ~20 us = ~0.6 ms/cmd (<=4% of a core at 60 cmd/s). Do you want it? If yes tell me the call set (SUBMIT_JM, WAIT_SEQ, IMPORT_SURFACE?) and I add trap indices 0..n sharing the externalMethod dispatch. Images are being built (nice 10, queued behind the other heavy jobs).
